spans.s: €1P. (rarely A.) (अटति, आट, अटितुम्, अटित). To wander or roam about (with loc.); roam over (sometimes with acc.); भो बटो भिक्षामट [[Sk.]] go to beg alms; आट नैकटिकाश्रमान् [[
]] -desid. अटिटिषति; -freq. अटाट्यते to wander about habitually, as a religious mendicant.

€1A. 
__1 To kill. 
__2 To transgress, go beyond (fig. also). -caus. 
__1 To lessen, diminish. 
__2 To despise, condemn, disregard.
